visual_identity.core_identity: An empty suit of medieval plate armor moving under magical force with no wearer inside.
visual_identity.silhouette: Complete humanoid plate-armor silhouette with articulated helmet, torso, arms, gauntlets, greaves, and armored feet moving as one hollow construct.
visual_identity.head_features: Closed or partly open helmet with visible emptiness where a face would be; no flesh, eyes, skull, or hidden wearer.
visual_identity.body_shape: Breastplate, pauldrons, vambraces, gauntlets, faulds, greaves, and boots form one plausible articulated suit.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Two articulated armored arms and two armored legs connected through the suit's normal joints; no biological limbs and no detached floating pieces.
visual_identity.surface: Broad simple metal plates with restrained dents and edge lines, leaving large open coloring regions.

scene_identity.size_impression: Human-sized hollow armor with believable medieval plate proportions.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Weight-bearing through armored feet or a clearly supported stance; deliberate guard, step, reach, or turn rather than floating.

anatomy.support_logic: weight-bearing through armored feet unless a page explicitly supplies another support

accuracy_checks: armor reads as one coherent suit

known_failure_modes.symptom: human or skeleton appears inside the suit
known_failure_modes.correction: remove all biological occupants and show empty darkness through helmet and joint gaps

known_failure_modes.symptom: armor pieces separate and hover independently
known_failure_modes.correction: restore one mechanically plausible connected suit with normal plate articulation
